svg.title: MediaLog — Final cut symbol
svg.desc: A brushed-chrome clapperboard stands on a glossy mirror floor between two cream-and-red twister columns, the cracktro centrepiece turned into a film mark. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The metal logo, mirror reflection and twisters of the 2000s cracktro revival frame a clapperboard instead of lettering; A chrome band with a white horizon gives the steel finish; red and cream twisters are the only colour.
